sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Book a session in the app, send your training footage ahead of time, and spend the call working on exactly what is limiting you. Every session ends with a written plan.
points: Video call with Mike, 60 or 90 minutes
Technique review on your own footage
A written block you can follow immediately
Session notes and history kept in the app

sections.heading: Who it is for
sections.body: Lifters stuck at a plateau, people coming back from injury, and coaches who want their own coaching eye sharpened.

faq.q: Do I have to commit to a block?
faq.a: No. Single sessions are fine, though most people book a four-session block.

faq.q: What if I need to move a session?
faq.a: Cancel from your coaching page up to 24 hours before and the session comes back to you to book again.
